From 89d030804831c4075496629343ae3bb3ae8ff58f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Suraj Kandpal <suraj.kandpal@intel.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Mar 2024 21:19:40 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] drm/xe/hdcp: Fix condition for hdcp gsc cs requirement

Add condition for check of hdcp gsc cs requirement rather than
assuming gsc cs to always be required when xe is loaded. It is not
required for display version < 14

--v2
-Use display version in commit message [Lucas]

Fixes: 152f2df954d8 ("drm/xe/hdcp: Enable HDCP for XE")
Signed-off-by: Suraj Kandpal <suraj.kandpal@intel.com>
Acked-by: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Lucas De Marchi <lucas.demarchi@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Uma Shankar <uma.shankar@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20240308154939.1940960-2-suraj.kandpal@intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/display/xe_hdcp_gsc.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/display/xe_hdcp_gsc.c
index dcde1d0ac1f8..25c73602ef55 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/display/xe_hdcp_gsc.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/display/xe_hdcp_gsc.c
@@ -32,7 +32,7 @@ struct intel_hdcp_gsc_message {
 
 bool intel_hdcp_gsc_cs_required(struct xe_device *xe)
 {
-	return true;
+	return DISPLAY_VER(xe) >= 14;
 }
 
 bool intel_hdcp_gsc_check_status(struct xe_device *xe)
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/xe/display/xe_hdcp_gsc.c`**
   - The function `intel_hdcp_gsc_cs_required` was modified to change its return value. 
   - The original implementation returned `true` unconditionally, indicating that the HDCP GSC (Graphics Security Controller) is always required.
   - The modified implementation now returns `true` only if the display version (`DISPLAY_VER(xe)`) is 14 or higher. This change introduces a conditional check based on the display version.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `xe_hdcp_gsc.c` directly addresses a bug related to the assumption that HDCP GSC is always required when the XE (Xe Graphics) driver is loaded. By implementing a version check, the patch ensures that the requirement for HDCP GSC is only enforced for display versions 14 and above, thereby preventing unnecessary enforcement for earlier versions. This change is part of a broader effort to improve the functionality and correctness of the HDCP implementation in the XE driver.

drm/xe/hdcp: Fix condition for hdcp gsc cs requirement

Fixes: 152f2df954d8 ("drm/xe/hdcp: Enable HDCP for XE")
Signed-off-by: Suraj Kandpal <suraj.kandpal@intel.com>
Acked-by: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Lucas De Marchi <lucas.demarchi@intel.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by an incorrect assumption in the `intel_hdcp_gsc_cs_required` function, which always returned `true`, indicating that the HDCP GSC was required regardless of the display version. This led to situations where the HDCP GSC was enforced for display versions lower than 14, where it is not actually required.

 {
-	return true;
+	return DISPLAY_VER(xe) >= 14;
 }
